I've implemented `GET /me/navigation` and the two text scans, but acceptance check 3 (the full `pnpm test:integration`) did not complete. The agent runner stopped it at its 1-hour background limit after 250 of 277 files, with 0 failures. It is recorded as stopped, not passed, and needs a rerun with a longer limit. Changes are uncommitted and the handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-BE-R2-backend-workflow-engineer.md`.

**Checks (logs in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-BE-R2-evidence/`)**

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| DG4 historical validator, start and end | 0, 0 | `PASS gate DG4 (historical)` |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, repo-wide Prettier check | 0 each | |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | 0 | 846 operations |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset, run 1 | **1** | 2 `architecture.test.ts` failures. One was a non-literal computed member access in my own `navigation.test.ts`, now fixed. The other was an empty `.claude` folder the file tools create inside source folders; I remove those before each run. |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset, run 2 | 0 | 2249 passed; 1429 passed; 259 passed, 2 skipped |
| `pnpm test`, `C.UTF-8` | 0 | same counts |
| `pnpm test:integration` | **stopped** | 250/277 files finished: 2597 tests, 0 failed, 1 skipped (that skip was already there). `contract.test.ts` (82 tests), `navigation.test.ts` and `branding.test.ts` ran and passed. |
| My 5 integration files, run on their own | 0 | 49/49 |

My four text-scan files are among the 27 that never ran in the full suite, so their only result is the run on their own. No pinned count needed changing (`getMyNavigation` has no request body). No migration and no new dependency.

**What was built**
- **Navigation (REQ-S03-007):**
  - It returns the 14 areas with their M0100–M0113 contents, and the server leaves out anything the caller can't see.
  - A user holding every role default sees all 14, with labels in English and Arabic. A Workstream Lead doesn't see Administration.
  - `getMyNavigation` is removed from my pending list and exercised in the contract test.
- **Text scans (REQ-PB-001, REQ-S21-001):**
  - The scans cover every en/ar UI string, every API string literal and problem text, the report and export templates, and one rendered sample per format (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV) in English and Arabic.
  - A planted claim and a planted "DG7" are caught in every format, which shows the scans actually read the text.
  - The SQL rules and the new TypeScript copies give the same answer on all 71 test samples and on more than 20,000 real product texts.

**Existing texts the scans flag (not changed; you decide)**
- **Four refusal messages whose exact wording ADR-0049 fixes**, e.g. "Branding text must not claim official PMI status or certification." The claim rule only treats "not" as a negation when it comes directly before the claim, and here "claim" sits in between. So the ADR's own wording breaks the ADR's own rule. Either reword the two messages (passing alternatives are in the handback) or widen the rule with a new migration.
- **The DG2 gate-snapshot note** in `workflows/gates.ts`, which says "…engineering delivery gates DG0-DG7". It is already-approved text, so changing it is your call.

Each one is listed in the test, matched by exact text, so any new violation still fails the scan.

**Needs from you or other owners**
- **Integration rerun:** run `pnpm test:integration` again with a background limit above 1 hour. The first 250 files took about an hour.
- **22 web label keys:** the items under My Work, Executive Overview, Transformations and Administration have no labels in `nav.json` yet. The en and provisional ar texts are proposed in the handback, and the test tracks these keys in a list that may only shrink.
- **Availability at the FE-C/FE-D merge:** those tasks can't edit my file. Unless their delivered screens are added to `DELIVERED_P5_SCREENS` in `identity/navigation.ts` when they merge, the navigation will keep calling those screens "planned", which would be untrue.
- **Test location:** no Vitest project runs `apps/api/test/text-scan/**`, so the scan helpers live there and the test files are under `apps/api/test/integration/text-scan/`.
- **Navigation schema:** there is no shared zod schema for the `Navigation` response, so its mirror sits in `p5-exercises-be-r2.ts` for now.
- **Regex difference:** in PostgreSQL, whether non-ASCII spaces count as whitespace in these rules depends on the database locale. The TypeScript copies match the C locale the test clusters use. The scans also check a whitespace-normalized copy of each text, so they stay strict on a Unicode-locale database.
- **Stale comment:** `identity/index.ts:6` (not my file) still says this route is a stub.

Ended at 13:13Z, after about 117 minutes.
